errors.text_span: 整体可见的刻度范围约从上方的0%到8%及下方的0%到8%
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly describes the Y-axis range as two separate positive ranges ("from 0% to 8% above and from 0% to 8% below"). The Y-axis represents a single continuous numerical scale from -8% to +8%. Describing it as two separate ranges is a fundamental misinterpretation of the axis structure.
